Everything is implemented and verified. The full gate passed on every stage.

| Stage | Result |
|---|---|
| codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit | ok |
| bun test | 8 pass, 0 fail |

**What was built**

- **Schema and migration.** Two new tables in `db/schema.ts`: `comments` (id, post_id, user_id, body, created_at) and `comment_reports` (id, comment_id, user_id, created_at) with a unique index on the (comment_id, user_id) pair. Migration generated under `db/migrations/20260925060914_add_comments/`.
- **Models and policy.** `Comment` (belongs to `author`, only `body` fillable, exports the hide threshold of 3) and `CommentReport`. `CommentPolicy` allows create and report for any signed-in user, and delete for the comment's author or the post's author. It is registered in `AuthorizationProvider`.
- **Routes and controller.** Three auth-guarded routes: `POST /posts/:id/comments` with a 1 to 2000 character body schema, `DELETE /comments/:id`, and `POST /comments/:id/report`. `CommentController` redirects to the post after store and destroy, answers a bare 204 on report, and skips inserting when the same user already reported.
- **Post page.** `PostController.show` now passes a `comments` prop of `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, oldest first, dropping any comment with three or more report rows. `destroy` removes the post's comments and their reports explicitly, because the SQLite connection does not enforce cascades. `posts/Show.tsx` renders the list, a comment form when signed in, and Delete or Report controls per comment.
- **Tests and docs.** `tests/CommentController.test.ts` covers the guest redirect, validation, ordering and author shape, delete permissions, hide threshold with report deduplication, and post deletion cleanup. An ADR under `docs/adr/0002-...` records the moderation rule.

Summary: I added community-moderated comments to the blog. The `comments` and `comment_reports` tables were added to `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration; new `Comment` and `CommentReport` models, a `CommentPolicy`, a `CommentValidator`, a `CommentResource`, and a `CommentController` live under `app/`, wired through `routes/web.ts` and `AuthorizationProvider`. `PostController.show` now supplies visible comments oldest first and `destroy` deletes a post's comments with it, and `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` renders the comment list, form, and Delete/Report controls. A new test file and an ADR round it out, and `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, and `bunx guren gate` all pass.
